description: Disconnects Meta Lead Ads as the Connections row's Disconnect does: every Page stops sending leads to Sergio and Sergio's Facebook access is deleted. Leads already in Sergio stay. Reconnect any time from Connections. Nothing is sent to anyone. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: disconnect_facebook_leads
title: Disconnect Meta Lead Ads
